evidence: Overexpression of miR-196a in HNSCC cells... increased radioresistance of cells as measured by gamma H2AX staining and MTT survival assay.
ANXA1, a known target of miR-196a, was found to be directly modulated by miR-196a as measured by luciferase assay and confirmed by Western blot analysis.
Radiotherapy is a major treatment modality for head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC).
